text:
Maya Chen: 8 minutes till all-hands. Quick checklist: captions, stream, local recorder, deck v7?
Lin (SRE): Recorder good. Noticed caption service latency ~3s in rehearsal, investigating NTP drift on caption host.
Omar - AV: Cam 2 exposure hunting; locked it. HDMI cable on B-cam a bit loose 121212 please avoid jostling the table.
Priya Gomez: Deck is v7 (final). Removed a third-party logo slide per legal. Link posted in #resources.
Maya Chen: Caption-bot, status?
caption-bot: Live captions running via captiond v1.4. Current avg latency: 3.1s. Fallback available: human-captioner on call if latency >5s.
Lin (SRE): If captiond drifts due to NTP, quick fixes:
```
sudo systemctl restart systemd-timesyncd
sudo systemctl restart captiond
# check: journalctl -u captiond -n 80 --no-pager
```
Omar - AV: If captions fail entirely, we can switch to human captioner (dial-in) and upload SRT post-call. Human captioner contact in pinned.
Tess - Product: Quick ask for Chriss remarks: can we call out the timeline for Dedicated pilot feedback loop? I'll keep it one bullet.
Chris - CEO: I'll mention pilot feedback and invite customers to the AMA. Keep it high level.
Maya Chen: Order tweak: leadership -> infra -> product -> customer Q&A. If captions go bad, flag in thread and we'll note in the recording.
deploy-bot: Heads-up: a minor canary deploy finishing in 4m; will pause on memory > 75% on inference-prod.
Priya Gomez: Also queueing two live Qs: 1) Dedicated SLA windows, 2) How pricing changes with quantization/Optimize. I'll add to the Q doc.
Lin (SRE): If OBS freezes during the call, commands:
```
sudo systemctl restart obs
# or: sudo pkill -9 obs && nohup /usr/bin/obs >/tmp/obs.log 2>&1 &
```
Maya Chen: If local recorder stalls, Omar please start manual capture on recorder-B and notify recorder-bot.
Omar - AV: Roger. Recorder-B command if needed:
```
ssh recorder-b
/usr/local/bin/start_capture --label allhands-2851234000
```
recorder-bot: Local recording started. Will upload to s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/2851234000/final.mp4 and s3://redwood-captions/all-hands/2851234000/final.srt (if captions available).
Lin (SRE): One more note: captiond token expired last week causing an upload fail. I've rotated keys and increased TTL. Should be stable.
Maya Chen: Presenters, please use wired LAN, mute when not speaking, and annotate any slide time swaps here. Also: clip requests 12 if you want a short highlight clip, post timestamp in this thread and AV will export.
Priya Gomez: Requesting a clip of the Dedicated pilot mention at ~10:40. Will post exact ts during the call.
Tess - Product: For follow-ups, I'll own the AMA doc and compile product + infra answers.
caption-bot: If automated captions degrade beyond threshold, will post: "Captions degraded; switching to human captioner. SRT will be attached post-call."
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. Final: I'll post the final speaker order in 2m and pin the runbook. See you in the room. :thumbsup:
